Wildfang Rampage.name: Wildfang Rampage
Wildfang Rampage.description: The user's signature move: they let the beast loose for a single rampage across the whole scene that swerves around allies and bystanders. Every enemy within a street's length is struck once, taking massive slashing and bludgeoning damage and being thrown down, and barricades, vehicles and walls in the path are smashed aside; afterward the user is forced back to human form and cannot change until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
